label: R1: build the doctor golden slice first (onboarding, diagnostics, control, ambiguity) on the existing corpus and capture a fresh baseline, making every later phase measurable.
R2: ship a single-route /doctor:setup umbrella composed from existing read-only batteries so measured empty onboarding phrases have one destination.
R3: admit doctor routes through generated per-route allow-list entries and scoring-compatibility blocks so _routes.yaml stays canonical and both projections regenerate.
R4: stage phrase admission: Wave A empty phrases (disable comment hygiene gate, runtime mirror drift, skill budget audit), Wave B contested phrases admitted one route at a time with ownership pins.
R5: bridge rendered names must be fully qualified /doctor:<command> <target> strings, because doctor routers refuse inferred targets and the brief label is user-visible.
R6: add exactly one bounded fallback sentence naming the doctor entry surface when no skill matched, deployed after the umbrella exists, keeping the directives block intact.
R7: refresh the stale validation-baselines numbers and the _routes.yaml consumption comment in the same change set that makes them stale-then-true.
Phase 1: measurement harness - author the slice files, capture the baseline, no runtime change, rollback is deleting the slice.

Phase 2: onboarding umbrella - command, presentation, battery, route, catalog row and count, then the bridge; gates: route-validate, drift guard, onboarding slice 9/9, controls unchanged, bounded-delta honored.
Phase 3-4: per-route diagnostics in two gated waves, then the guidance surface and documentation refresh, each landing with the same structural gates plus the outcome slice and reach pins.

direction: Shipping the umbrella before the measurement harness
reason: Without the slice, the umbrella admission cannot be distinguished from theft or a tie.

direction: Deferring the harness to the end of the plan
reason: The harness is the gate for every other phase.
